401: ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am devoted to the Guru; meeting Him, I have made the True Lord my life's purpose. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਗੁਨ ਅਪਸਗੁਨ. ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਹਿ; ਜਿਸੁ. ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Good omens and bad omens affect those who do not keep the Lord in their consciousness.
ਤਿਸੁ. ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
The messenger of death does not approach one who is pleasing to the Lord God. ॥2॥
ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ. ਜਪ ਤਪ ਜੇਤੇ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Above all deeds of charity and donations, meditation and penance, is the Name.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
One who chants with the tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har — his works are brought to perfect completion. ॥3॥
ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਗਏ; ਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਨ. ਬੀਆ ॥
His fears are dispelled, and his doubts and attachments are gone; he sees no one as a stranger.
ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੧੨੦॥
O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God has preserved him, and no pain afflicts him any more. ॥4॥18॥120॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤਵਿ. ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ; ਆਗੈ ਭਾਵਉ. ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
I long to remember Him, that I may obtain all comforts; but I do not know whether I shall be pleasing to Him.
ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ. ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ; ਦੂਸਰ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
There is only One Giver; all others are beggars. To whom else could I go? ॥1॥
When I beg from others, I am ashamed.
ਸਗਲ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਕਉਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The One Lord and Master is the Sovereign over all; who else is equal to Him? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਊਠਉ ਬੈਸਉ. ਰਹਿ ਭਿ, ਨ ਸਾਕਉ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਾਵਉ ॥
Standing up and sitting down, I cannot live without Him; I search and search for the vision of His Darshan.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ. ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ, ਸਨਾਤਨ ਸਨਤਕੁਮਾਰ; ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ. ਮਹਲੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
Even Brahma and the others, and the sages Sanak, Sanandan, Sanaatan and Sanat Kumaar, find it difficult to obtain the Mansion of His presence. ॥2॥
ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
He is inaccessible, inaccessible, of unfathomable wisdom; His value cannot be estimated.
ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ. ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੩॥
I have taken to the sanctuary of the True Being, the Primal Lord, and I meditate on the True Guru. ॥3॥
ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਕਾਟਿਓ ਬੰਧੁ ਗਰਾਵਉ ॥
God, the Lord and Master, has become kind and compassionate; He has cut the noose from around my neck.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ; ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ. ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੧॥
Says Nanak, now that I have obtained the company of the Holy, I shall not have to be born again. ॥4॥1॥121॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ. ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ; ਗਾਵਉ ਜਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Inwardly, I sing His praises, and outwardly, I sing His praises; I sing His praises while awake and asleep.
ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲਨ ਕਉ. ਤੋਸਾ ਦੀਨੑਾ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
The traders in the Name of the Lord of the Universe have given me these provisions to carry along. ॥1॥
I have forgotten all else, totally forgotten it.
ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ; ਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The perfect Guru has given me the gift of the Name; this alone is my support. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦੂਖਨਿ ਗਾਵਉ. ਸੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ; ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
I sing His praises while suffering, and I sing His praises while at peace; I contemplate Him while walking on the path.
ਨਾਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਗੁਰਿ. ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਆ; ਮੋਰੀ. ਤਿਸਾ ਬੁਝਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
The Guru has implanted the Name firmly within my mind, and my thirst has been quenched. ॥2॥
ਦਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ. ਰੈਨੀ ਗਾਵਉ; ਗਾਵਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਰਸਨਾਰੀ ॥
I sing His praises by day, and I sing His praises by night; I sing them with every breath, with my tongue.
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
In the True Congregation, this faith is established, that the Lord is with us, in life and in death. ॥3॥
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Bless servant Nanak with this gift, O God, that he may obtain and enshrine in his heart the dust of the feet of the Saints;
ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਕਥਾ. ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਉ; ਮਸਤਕੁ. ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੨॥
with my ears may I hear Your sermon, with my eyes behold the vision of Your Darshan, and may my forehead rest at the Guru's feet. ॥4॥2॥122॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ; ਤੇ ਪਾਹੁਨ. ਦੋ ਦਾਹਾ ॥
Those whom you believe to be permanent are guests here for only a couple of days.
402: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ. ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ; ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਅਸਨਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
Children, spouse, home and all possessions — attachment to all of these is false. ॥1॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਹੈ. ਹਾ ਹਾ ॥
O mind, why do you burst out laughing?
ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੁ. ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ; ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨੁ. ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
See with your eyes that these things are only a mirage; so earn the profit of meditation on the One Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸਤਰ. ਦੇਹ ਓਢਾਨੇ; ਦਿਨ ਦੋਇ ਚਾਰਿ. ਭੋਰਾਹਾ ॥
Like the clothes worn on the body, they wear out in a few days.
ਭੀਤਿ ਊਪਰੇ ਕੇਤਕੁ ਧਾਈਐ; ਅੰਤਿ ਓਰਕੋ ਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
How long can one run along a wall? Ultimately, one comes to its end. ॥2॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਅੰਭ. ਕੁੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ; ਪਰਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
Like salt preserved in its container, which dissolves when it is put into water,
ਆਵਗਿ ਆਗਿਆ. ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ; ਉਠਿ ਜਾਸੀ. ਮੁਹਤ ਚਸਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
when the Order of the Supreme Lord God comes, the soul arises and departs, in an instant. ॥3॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ. ਲੇਖੈ ਚਾਲਹਿ. ਲੇਖੈ ਬੈਸਹਿ; ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
O mind, your steps are numbered, your moments sitting there are numbered, and the breaths you take are numbered.
ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ. ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ; ਉਬਰੇ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਓਟਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੩॥
Sing forever the praises of the Lord, O Nanak, and you shall be saved, under the shelter of the feet of the True Guru. ॥4॥1॥123॥
ਅਪੁਸਟ ਬਾਤ ਤੇ. ਭਈ ਸੀਧਰੀ; ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਜਨਈ ॥
That which was upside down has been set upright; the deadly enemies and adversaries have become friends.
ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ; ਮਲੀਨ ਬੁਧਿ. ਹਛਨਈ ॥੧॥
In the darkness, the jewel shines forth, and the impure understanding has become pure. ॥1॥
When the Lord of the Universe became merciful,
ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I met the True Guru, and obtained the fruits of peace, wealth and the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ; ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ॥
No one knew me, the miserly wretch, but now I have become famous throughout all the worlds.
ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠਨੋ. ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ; ਹੁਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਈ ॥੨॥
Before, no one would even let me sit with them, but now all worship my feet. ॥2॥
ਆਢ ਆਢ ਕਉ. ਫਿਰਤ ਢੂੰਢਤੇ; ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ. ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ॥
I used to wander in search of pennies, but now all the desires of my mind are satisfied.
ਏਕੁ ਬੋਲੁ ਭੀ. ਖਵਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੀਤਲਈ ॥੩॥
I could not bear even a single harsh word, but now, in the company of the Holy, I am cooled and soothed. ॥3॥
ਏਕ ਜੀਹ. ਗੁਣ ਕਵਨ ਵਖਾਨੈ; ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮਈ ॥
What glorious virtues of the inaccessible, unfathomable, profound Lord can one tongue describe?
ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੪॥
Please make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak seeks the Lord's sanctuary. ॥4॥2॥124॥
ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ. ਲਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਢੀਲਾ ਢੀਲਾ; ਤੋਟੇ ਕਉ. ਬੇਗਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
O fool, you are so slow to earn your profits, and so quick to run up losses.
ਸਸਤ ਵਖਰੁ. ਤੂੰ ਘਿੰਨਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਪਾਪੀ ਬਾਧਾ ਰੇਨਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
You do not purchase the cheap merchandise; O sinner, you are tied to your debts. ॥1॥
O True Guru, You are my only hope.
ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ. ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਓਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your Name, O Supreme Lord God, is the Purifier of sinners; this alone is my shelter. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੰਧਣ ਵੈਣ ਸੁਣਹਿ. ਉਰਝਾਵਹਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਲਕਾਇਆ ॥
Listening to evil talk, you are entangled in it, but you are hesitant to chant the Name.
ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਮਾਹਿਓ; ਬੂਝੀ ਉਲਟਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
You are delighted by slanderous talk; your understanding is upside down. ॥2॥
ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਅਖਾਧਿ ਖਾਹਿ. ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
Others' wealth, others' spouses and the slander of others — eating the uneatable, you have gone mad.
ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਸਿਉ. ਰੁਚਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ; ਸਤਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਛੋਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
You have not enshrined love for the True faith of righteousness; hearing the Truth, you become angry. ॥3॥
ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
O God, merciful to the meek, compassionate Lord and Master, Your Name is the support of Your devotees.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਹਿ ਸਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਓ; ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੫॥
Nanak has come to Your sanctuary with longing, O God; make him Your own, and preserve his honour. ॥4॥3॥125॥
ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ; ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
They are attached to falsehood, clinging to the transitory, bound by emotional attachment to Maya.
ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ. ਸੋ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਭਏ ਆਂਧੇ ॥੧॥
Wherever they go, they do not think of the Lord; they are blinded by intellectual egotism. ॥1॥
O mind, O renunciate, why do you not worship Him in adoration?
ਕਾਚ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਸਤਾ; ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ, ਬਿਖੈ ਕੀ ਬਿਆਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You dwell in that flimsy chamber of the body, with all the sins of corruption. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ, ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ; ਪਲੁ ਖਿਨੁ. ਛੀਜੈ ਅਰਜਾਧੇ ॥
Crying out "mine, mine", your days and nights pass away; moment by moment, your life is running out.
403: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਠੈ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ; ਝੂਠ ਧੰਧਿ ਦੁਰਗਾਧੇ ॥੨॥
As the fly is lured by the sweet taste, so is the mortal caught in false business and in filth. ॥2॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ; ਇਹ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਧੇ ॥
Sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment — the mortal is entangled in these pleasures of the senses.
ਦੀਈ ਭਵਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਨਮਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
The Primal Lord, the Architect of destiny, has made him wander in reincarnation, over and over again. ॥3॥
ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ. ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ, ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਧੇ ॥
When the Destroyer of the pains of the poor becomes merciful, then, meeting the Guru, all peace is found.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ; ਮਾਰਿ ਕਾਢੀ. ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧੇ ॥੪॥
Says Nanak, I meditate on Him day and night; He has struck down and driven out all my sickness. ॥4॥
This is how to meditate, O brothers, on the Primal Lord, the Architect of destiny.
ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੬॥
The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful, and the pains of birth and death are gone. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥4॥4॥126॥
ਨਿਮਖ ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਦ ਕਾਰਣਿ; ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
For a moment of sexual pleasure, you shall suffer in pain for millions of days.
ਘਰੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
For an instant, you may savour pleasure, but afterwards you shall regret it, again and again. ॥1॥
O blind man, meditate on the Lord, the Lord, your King.
ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ; ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your day is drawing near. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਲਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲੋ; ਆਕ ਨੀਮ ਕੋ. ਤੂੰਮਰੁ ॥
You are deceived, beholding with your eyes the bitter melon and the swallow-wort, as bitter as neem.
ਜੈਸਾ ਸੰਗੁ. ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਸਿਉ ਹੈ ਰੇ; ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ॥੨॥
Like companionship with a poisonous snake, so is the desire for another's spouse. ॥2॥
ਬੈਰੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤਾ; ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਅਮਾਨਾ ॥
For the sake of your enemy, Maya, you commit sins, while the real treasure lies neglected.
ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ. ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੀ; ਸਾਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
You keep company with those who shall desert you, and you are at odds with your true Friend. ॥3॥
ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ. ਇਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ; ਸੋ ਉਬਰਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
The whole world is entangled in this way; he alone is saved, who has the perfect Guru.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ; ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨੭॥
Says Nanak, he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, and his body becomes pure. ॥4॥5॥127॥
ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ. ਸੋਈ ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਿਓ; ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਮੁਕਰਾਨੀ ॥
Whatever they do in secret, You see, Lord, yet the foolish and stupid deny it.
ਆਪ ਕਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਲੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
By their own actions they are bound down, and in the end they regret and repent. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
My God knows, ahead of time, all things.
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੂਸੇ. ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਤ ਪਰਦਾ; ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O one deceived by doubt, you hide your actions, but afterwards you shall have to confess what is in your heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ. ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ; ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
To whatever they are attached, to that they remain joined; what can any mere mortal do?
ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੮॥
Please forgive me, O Supreme Lord Master; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ॥2॥6॥128॥
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ. ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਆਪੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
He Himself preserves the honour of His servant; He Himself inspires him to chant His Name.
ਜਹ ਜਹ ਕਾਜ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ; ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Wherever the work and affairs of His servant are, there the Lord hurries to be. ॥1॥
To His servant, the Lord shows Himself to be near at hand.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਤਤਕਾਲ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever the servant asks of his Lord and Master, immediately comes to pass. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ; ਜੋ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
I am a sacrifice to that servant who is pleasing to his God.
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ, ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਰਸਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੯॥
Hearing of his glory, the mind is rejuvenated, and Nanak comes to touch his feet. ॥2॥7॥129॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਨਟੂਆ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ. ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ; ਜੈਸਾ ਹੈ. ਓਹੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਰੇ ॥
The actor displays many disguises, but remains just as he is.
ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਸੁਖਹਿ. ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
So the soul wanders through countless incarnations in doubt, but does not come to dwell in peace. ॥1॥
404: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ. ਹਮਾਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਆਨੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
O Saints, my friends and companions: without the Lord, Har, Har, all is transitory.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ; ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Joining the company of the Holy and singing the glorious praises of the Lord, this priceless human life is won. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
God created Maya of the three qualities; tell me, how can it be crossed over?
ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰ. ਅਗਾਹ ਗਾਖਰੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Its whirlpools are vast and fathomless, so difficult to cross; only through the Guru's Word is one carried across. ॥2॥
ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ; ਤਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
Searching and searching, reflecting and contemplating, Nanak has come to know this essence of reality:
ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ; ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ. ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੩॥੧॥੧੩੦॥
remembering in meditation the priceless treasure of the Name, the jewel of the mind is pleased and satisfied. ॥3॥1॥130॥
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ. ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ. ਸੋ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
By the Guru's grace, He dwells in my mind; whatever I ask for, I receive.
ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨਾ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
This mind is satisfied with the love of the Name; it does not go out wandering anywhere any more. ॥1॥
ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ. ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ; ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
My Lord and Master is the highest of all; night and day, I sing His glorious praises.
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ; ਤਿਸ ਤੇ. ਤੁਝਹਿ ਡਰਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; I would keep you, O mind, in fear and awe of Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਉ ਅਵਰਹਿ ਚੀਤਿ. ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
When I behold God, my Lord and Master, I do not pay any attention to anyone else.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ. ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੇਟਿ. ਲਿਖਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੩੧॥
God Himself has robed His servant Nanak in honour; erasing doubt and fear, I write only His Name. ॥2॥2॥131॥
ਚਾਰਿ ਬਰਨ. ਚਉਹਾ ਕੇ ਮਰਦਨ; ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ. ਕਰ ਤਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
The passions crush the four castes, and toss the followers of the six schools of philosophy on the palms of their hands.
ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਿਆਨੇ; ਪੰਚਹੁ ਹੀ. ਮੋਹਿ ਛਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
The beautiful, refined, attractive and wise — the five demons have deceived and enticed them all. ॥1॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਸੂਰਬੀਰ; ਐਸੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
Who is that mighty one who, meeting the Guru, has killed these five heroic warriors?
ਜਿਨਿ ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ. ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਗੁਦਾਰੇ; ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ. ਇਹ ਕਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who conquers and destroys these five is perfect in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਵਡੀ ਕੋਮ. ਵਸਿ ਭਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਮੁਹਕਮ ਫਉਜ. ਹਠਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
Theirs is a great and powerful tribe; they cannot be controlled, and they do not run away; their army is strong and unyielding.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਨਿਰਦਲਿਆ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਝਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੩੨॥
Says Nanak, that humble being who is under the protection of the company of the Holy crushes them. ॥2॥3॥132॥
ਨੀਕੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ. ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਊਤਮ; ਆਨ ਸਗਲ ਰਸ. ਫੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The sublime sermon of the Lord is the best thing for the soul; all other tastes are bland. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ, ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਖਟੁ ਬੇਤੇ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਛੁ. ਲਾਈਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
It is so full of virtue and melody; the silent sages who know the six Shastras proclaim that nothing else is worthy. ॥1॥
ਬਿਖਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਅਪਾਰੀ ਸਹਜਾਰੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩੩॥
It is the antidote to corruption, unique, infinite and bringing peace; O Nanak, it is drunk in the company of the Holy. ॥2॥4॥133॥
ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਨਿਮਖ, ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My Beloved Bani showers the stream of ambrosial nectar; the Guru has not let it leave my mind, even for an instant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਨ. ਸਰਸਨ ਹਰਸਨ; ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀ. ਕਰਤਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Through it, I behold Him, touch Him, and am rejuvenated and delighted, imbued with the love of the Creator. ॥1॥
ਖਿਨੁ ਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ, ਹਰਿ ਦਮ. ਨਹ ਜਮ; ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩੪॥

Dwelling on it even for an instant, one reaches the Guru; contemplating the Lord with every breath, death does not touch him. O Nanak, keep the Lord as a garland around your neck and in your heart. ॥2॥5॥134॥
Sublime is the company of the Holy. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਹਰ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ, ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Every hour, every minute and every moment, one sings and speaks of the Lord of the Universe, Govind, Govind. ॥1॥
ਚਾਲਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Walking, sitting and sleeping, one chants the Lord's praise; His feet dwell in the mind and body. ॥2॥
ਹਂਉ ਹਉਰੋ. ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਉਰੋ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਨਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੩੫॥
I am small, and You are great, O Lord and Master; Nanak has realised the value of Your sanctuary. ॥3॥6॥135॥
405: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਨਪਾ; ਭਜੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Renounce all your cleverness, and meditate on the Supreme Lord God, the Formless Lord.
ਏਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਾਝਹੁ; ਸਗਲ ਦੀਸੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Without the One True Name, everything appears as dust. ॥1॥
Know that God is always with you.
ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੀਐ; ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace, one understands, and is imbued with the love of the One Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਏਕ ਕੇਰੀ; ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
Seek the shelter of the One all-powerful Lord; there is no other place of rest.
ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ; ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੨॥
The vast and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over by continually singing the glorious praises of the Lord. ॥2॥
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Birth and death are overcome, and one does not have to suffer in the city of death.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ; ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
He alone obtains the treasure of the Name, upon whom God shows His mercy. ॥3॥
ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਏਕੋ; ਏਕ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
The One Lord is my anchor and support; the One Lord is the only strength of my mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਪੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੬॥
O Nanak, joining the company of the Holy, meditate on Him; without the Lord, there is no other at all. ॥4॥1॥136॥
ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ; ਦੀਏ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
Soul, mind, body and the breath of life belong to God; He has given all tastes and pleasures.
ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸਰਣਿ ਰਾਖਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
He is the friend of the poor, the Giver of life, able to protect those who seek His sanctuary. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੇ; ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Here and hereafter, He is our help and companion; embrace love for the One Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ; ਤਰਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
People ponder over the Vedas and the Shastras to cross over the world-ocean.
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
They perform so many rituals, good deeds and religious rites, but above all of these is the practice of the Name. ॥2॥
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਮਿਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
Sexual desire, anger and egotism are dispelled, meeting the Divine True Guru.
ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ; ਭਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
Implant the Name firmly within, and perform devotional worship of the Lord; sublime is the service of God. ॥3॥
ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੇਰੀ; ਤੂੰ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
I seek the sanctuary of Your feet, O merciful Lord; You are the honour of the dishonoured.
ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩੭॥
You are the support of my soul and breath of life; God is Nanak's strength. ॥4॥2॥137॥
ਡੋਲਿ. ਡੋਲਿ. ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
Wavering and wavering, he suffers in terrible pain, without the company of the Holy.
ਖਾਟਿ ਲਾਭੁ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
Earn the profit of the sublime essence of the Lord of the Universe, imbued with the love of the One Supreme Lord God. ॥1॥
Chant continually the Name of the Lord.
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
With each and every breath, meditate on God, and abandon love for any other. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ॥
God is the Doer, the Cause of causes, all-powerful; He Himself is the Giver of life.
ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
Renounce all your cleverness, and meditate on God, twenty-four hours a day. ॥2॥
ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੀ; ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
He is our friend, companion, help and associate; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.
ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Enshrine His lotus feet within your heart; He is the support of the soul. ॥3॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
Show Your mercy, O Supreme Lord God, that I may sing Your glorious virtues and praises.
ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩੮॥
All peace and greatest glory are in it; Nanak lives by chanting the Name. ॥4॥3॥138॥
ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ. ਕਰਾਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
I make the effort; inspire me to make it, O Lord and Master, as I behold You in the company of the Holy.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਰਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗਨਿ; ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
Dye me in the colour of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; You Yourself, God, dye me in Your love. ॥1॥
Within my mind, I chant the Name of the Lord.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Show Your mercy, and dwell within my heart; please, become my help and support. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
Listening and listening to Your Name, O Beloved, I long to behold You, God.
406: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ. ਕਿਰਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ; ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
Please be kind to me, Your humble worm; this is my only desire and purpose. ॥2॥
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ. ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਹਮਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
My body and wealth are Yours; You are my God; nothing is in my power.
ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ. ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ; ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
As You keep me, so do I live; I eat what You give me. ॥3॥
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ; ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
The sins of countless incarnations are washed away by bathing in the dust of the Lord's humble servants.
ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ. ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਨਾਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩੯॥
Through loving devotional worship, doubt and fear depart, O Nanak, and the Lord is seen ever-present. ॥4॥4॥139॥
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸੋ ਪਾਏ. ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Your vision is inaccessible and unfathomable; he alone obtains it, who has such destiny written on his forehead.
ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ. ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
The merciful God Himself has bestowed His mercy, and the True Guru has blessed him with the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
The Divine Guru has saved even the Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ. ਜਿ ਮੁਘਦ ਹੋਤੇ; ਸਭਿ ਲਗੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Even the filthy fools and idiots have all become Your servants. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ. ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਤਾ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
You Yourself are the Creator, the Support of the whole world; You are contained in all.
ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਆ; ਸਭ ਪਈ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
The Righteous Judge of Dharma is wonderstruck, for all are falling at Your feet. ॥2॥
ਸਤਜੁਗੁ ਤ੍ਰੇਤਾ. ਦੁਆਪਰੁ ਭਣੀਐ; ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਊਤਮੋ. ਜੁਗਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
The Golden Age, the Silver Age and the Brass Age are spoken of, but the Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the best of all the ages.
ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ. ਸੁ ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ; ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਕੜੀਐ. ਕਿਸੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
The hand that does the deed is the hand that receives its reward; no one is seized in place of another. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਹਿ, ਜਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਚਹਿ; ਏਹੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ॥
O Dear Lord, You do whatever Your devotees ask; this is Your innate nature.
ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ; ਅਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪੦॥
With palms pressed together, Nanak begs this gift: O Lord, bless him with the vision of Your Saints. ॥4॥5॥140॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
have carried the worthless across. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ. ਦੁਸਟ ਅਪਵਾਦੀ; ਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Even the most quarrelsome, wicked and slanderous have been purified in Your company. ॥1॥
ਜਨਮ ਭਵੰਤੇ. ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤੇ; ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Those who wandered in reincarnation and were cast into hell — even their families have been saved. ॥2॥
ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ; ਸੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
Those whom no one knew, and whom no one respected, have become manifest at the Lord's door. ॥3॥
ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ, ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪੧॥
What praise or greatness can I give You? Nanak is a sacrifice to You, each and every moment. ॥4॥1॥141॥
ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ. ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ; ਮਿਥਿਆ ਗਹਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੧॥
He is intoxicated with attachment to his family and with sensual pleasures, and grasps at what is false. ॥1॥
ਮਿਥਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ. ਸੁਪਨ ਆਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸ; ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥
He longs for false desires and the joys and pleasures of dreams, and with his mind and mouth he calls them true. ॥2॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੰਗੇ; ਤਿਲੁ ਮਰਮੁ. ਨ ਲਹੇ ॥੩॥
The ambrosial treasure of the Name is with him, but he does not understand even a tiny bit of its mystery. ॥3॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਿ ਆਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪੨॥
In His mercy, He keeps them in the True Congregation; O Nanak, they remain in His sanctuary. ॥4॥2॥142॥
That alone is what I want: the love of my Beloved. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਨਿਕ ਮਾਣਿਕ. ਗਜ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਲਾਲਨ; ਨਹ ਨਾਹ ਨਹੀ ॥੧॥
Gold, jewels, giant pearls and rubies — I have no need for them, none at all. ॥1॥
ਰਾਜ ਨ ਭਾਗ ਨ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਸਾਦਨ ॥ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਚਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Royal power, fortune, commands and delicacies — I want nothing, nothing of these. ॥2॥
407: ਚਰਨਨ ਸਰਨਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਬੰਦਨ ॥ ਸੁਖੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਹੀ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੪੩॥
Seeking the sanctuary of the feet of the Saints and bowing to them, I find the peace of peace; O Nanak, my burning is taken away, meeting my Beloved's love. ॥3॥3॥143॥
The Guru has shown the Lord to me with my eyes. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਈਤਹਿ ਊਤਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ, ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ; ਤੂੰਹੀ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੧॥
Here and there, in each and every heart, in each and every heart, You alone, You alone, O Enticing Lord. ॥1॥
ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ. ਧਾਰਨ ਧਰਨਾ; ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੨॥
You are the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Support of the earth; You are the One and Only Beautiful Lord. ॥2॥
ਸੰਤਨ ਪਰਸਨ. ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਦਰਸਨ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਇਨਾ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੪੪॥
Touching the feet of the Saints, I am a sacrifice to their vision; O Nanak, I sleep in the peace of peace. ॥3॥4॥144॥
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is priceless.
One who has it lives in intuitive peace and poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ. ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਓਹੁ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ॥੧॥
The Lord is my companion and help; He shall not forsake me; He is unfathomable and unweighable. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਈ. ਬਾਪੁ ਮੋਰੋ ਮਾਈ; ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੨॥
He is my Beloved, my brother, father and mother; He is the support of His devotees. ॥2॥
ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੩॥੫॥੧੪੫॥
The unseen Lord has been revealed through the Guru; O Nanak, this is the wondrous play of the Lord. ॥3॥5॥145॥
Please let me continue Your devotional worship.
O Lord and Master, I have come to You with longing. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ. ਹੋਇ ਸਕਾਰਥੁ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Through the treasure of the Name, life becomes fruitful; please enshrine Your feet within my heart. ॥1॥
ਏਹ ਮੁਕਤਾ. ਏਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ; ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
This is liberation, and this is the way of life: please keep me in the company of the Saints. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ. ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੪੬॥
May I meditate on the Name and be absorbed in intuitive poise, O Nanak, singing the glorious praises of the Lord. ॥3॥6॥146॥
The feet of the Lord and Master are so beautiful.
The Lord's Saints obtain them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ. ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਆ; ਗੁਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
They eradicate their self-conceit and serve the Lord; imbued with His love, they sing His glorious praises. ॥1॥
ਏਕਹਿ ਆਸਾ. ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ; ਆਨ. ਨ ਭਾਵੇ ॥੨॥
They place their hopes in Him alone; they thirst for the vision of His Darshan, and nothing else pleases them. ॥2॥
ਦਇਆ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ, ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੇ ॥੩॥੭॥੧੪੭॥
This is Your mercy, Lord; what can Your poor creatures do? Nanak is devoted, a sacrifice to You. ॥3॥7॥147॥
Remember the One Lord in meditation within your mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ. ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਹੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Meditate on the Name, and enshrine it within your heart; without Him, there is no other. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਈਐ, ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਗਲੇ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Entering God's sanctuary, all rewards are obtained, and all pains are taken away. ॥2॥
ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ. ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਹੀ ॥੩॥੮॥੧੪੮॥
He is the Giver of all beings, the Architect of destiny; O Nanak, He is contained in each and every heart. ॥3॥8॥148॥
One who forgets the Lord is dead. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ. ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ. ਸੁਖੀਆ ਹੂਆ ॥੧॥
One who meditates on the Name obtains all rewards; that person becomes happy. ॥1॥
ਰਾਜੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ, ਹਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਬਾਧਿਓ. ਨਲਿਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੨॥
One who calls himself a king, and acts in ego, is caught by his doubt, like the parrot caught on the stick. ॥2॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥੯॥੧੪੯॥
Says Nanak, one who meets the True Guru becomes steady and eternal. ॥3॥9॥149॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਓਹੁ. ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ॥ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ; ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
That love is forever fresh and new, which is for one's own Beloved Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ; ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਚੈ ॥੧॥
One who is pleasing to God shall not be born again; he is absorbed in the loving devotional worship and love of the Lord. ॥1॥
408: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਅਪਨੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੦॥
One meets God by dedicating this mind to Him; O Lord, show Your mercy, that Nanak may obtain the Name. ॥2॥1॥150॥
ਮਿਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ. ਕੋ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meet me, O my Beloved Lord; without You, no one can give me comfort. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
People perform many rituals according to the Simritees and Shastras, but without the vision of Your Darshan, God, there is no peace. ॥1॥
ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ, ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ, ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੧॥
People have grown weary of observing fasts, vows and self-discipline; O Nanak, in the sanctuary of the Holy, one dwells with God. ॥2॥2॥151॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਦਿ ਸੋਇਓ; ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
The mortal sleeps in the intoxication of corruption and Maya; he does not come to understand.
ਪਕਰਿ ਕੇਸ. ਜਮਿ ਉਠਾਰਿਓ; ਤਦ ਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Seizing him by the hair, the messenger of death pulls him up; only then does he come to his senses. ॥1॥
ਲੋਭ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਲਾਗੇ; ਹਿਰਿ ਵਿਤ, ਚਿਤ ਦੁਖਾਹੀ ॥
Attached to greed and corruption, they steal the wealth of others and cause pain to their hearts.
ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗੁਨਾ ਕੈ. ਮਾਨਿ ਮਾਤੇ; ਅਸੁਰ. ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Intoxicated with pride in what passes away in an instant, the demons do not understand. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ; ਸੁਨੈ ਨਾਹੀ. ਡੋਰਾ ॥
The Vedas, the Shastras and the Saints proclaim it, but the deaf do not hear.
ਨਿਪਟਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰਿ. ਮੂਕਾ; ਪਛੁਤਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਭੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
When the game of life is over, and he has lost, and he breathes his last, the fool regrets and repents in his mind. ॥2॥
ਡਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ. ਗੈਰ ਵਜਹਿ ਭਰਿਆ; ਦੀਵਾਨ ਲੇਖੈ. ਨ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
He pays the fine for nothing, and he is not accepted in the Court of the Lord.
ਜੇਂਹ ਕਾਰਜਿ. ਰਹੈ ਓਲੑਾ; ਸੋਇ. ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Those deeds which would have covered his faults — those deeds he has not done. ॥3॥
ਐਸੋ ਜਗੁ, ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ; ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
When the Guru showed me such a world, I began to sing the praises of the One Lord.
ਮਾਨੁ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ; ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੨॥
Renouncing pride, power and cleverness, Nanak has come to the Lord's sanctuary. ॥4॥1॥152॥
Deal in the Name of the Lord of the Universe.
ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਏ, ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ; ਪੰਚ ਨਾਦ, ਤੂਰ ਬਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Please the Holy Saints, sing the glorious praises, and obtain the Beloved; the melody of the five instruments resounds. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਏ, ਸਹਜਾਏ ਦਰਸਾਏ; ਅਬ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ॥
Obtaining His mercy, I have beheld His vision with intuitive ease; now I am imbued with the love of the Lord of the Universe.
ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਿ, ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਥ; ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
Serving the Saints, I feel love for my Lord and Master, and I am dyed in the colour of my Beloved. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰਹਸਾਏ, ਨਹੀ ਆਏ; ਸਹਜਾਏ. ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
One who implants the Guru's spiritual wisdom firmly within the mind rejoices, and is not reincarnated again; in intuitive poise, he finds the treasure within the mind.
ਸਭ ਤਜੀ; ਮਨੈ ਕੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰਾ ॥
He has renounced all the desires of his mind.
ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਭਇਆ; ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
It has been so long, so very long, since I saw You, Lord; my mind feels such a great thirst.
ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ. ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
Please reveal to me the vision of Your Darshan, O Lord, and show Yourself to me.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ. ਸਰਣਿ ਆਏ; ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੩॥
Meek Nanak has entered Your sanctuary; please take him in Your embrace. ॥2॥2॥153॥
How rare is the one who breaks down the treacherous fortress,
ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਧੋਹ ਮੋਹ; ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and turns his mind away from hope, thirst, deception, attachment and doubt. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਾਨ; ਇਹ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਛੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
He casts off the diseases of sexual desire, anger, greed and pride. ॥1॥
ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ; ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
In the company of the Saints, imbued with the love of the Name, I sing the glorious praises of the Lord of the Universe.
Night and day, I meditate on God.
I have conquered and demolished the wall of doubt.
O Nanak, the Name is my only treasure. ॥2॥3॥154॥
Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed.
Remember in your mind the Name of the Lord of the Universe.
Meditation on the Lord is the only fruitful action. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
409: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ. ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਿਥਿਆ; ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
Renounce pride, attachment, corruption and falsehood, and chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
O mind, grasp the feet of the Saints. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ, ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਾਵਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਿਮਰਿ. ਜਾਗੁ ॥
God is the Sustainer of the world, merciful to the meek, the Purifier of sinners, the Transcendent Lord; remember the Lord's feet in meditation, and awaken.
Perform devotional worship, O Nanak, and your destiny shall be fulfilled. ॥2॥4॥155॥
ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਅਨੰਦੀ; ਖੇਲੁ ਰੀ. ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The blissful Lord has shown me the play of the world — pleasure and pain, and detachment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭੈ. ਨਿਰਭੈ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ; ਖਿਨਹੂੰ. ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
One moment, the mortal is in fear; the next moment, he is fearless; in a moment, he gets up and departs.
ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਰਸ. ਭੋਗਨ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ; ਖਿਨਹੂ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
One moment, he enjoys pleasures; the next moment, he leaves them and departs. ॥1॥
ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ. ਤਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਪੂਜਾ; ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭਰਮਾਇਓ ॥
One moment, he practises Yoga and intense meditation, and all sorts of worship; the next moment, he wanders in doubt.
ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੫੬॥
In an instant, by His grace, in the company of the Holy, O Nanak, the Lord attaches him to His love. ॥2॥5॥156॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, Govind, Govind.
Cherish the Lord, Har, Har, in your mind.
ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ. ਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Whatever the Guru has said, enshrine it in your consciousness.
Break away from others, and turn your mind back from them.
ਐਸੇ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ, ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In this way, you shall find your Beloved, O my companion. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the pool of the world is the mud of attachment.
Stuck in it, one's feet cannot walk towards the Lord.
The fool is stuck in it,
and makes all sorts of other efforts.
ਤਉ ਨਿਕਸੈ; ਸਰਨਿ ਪੈ. ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥
Only by entering the Lord's sanctuary can he get free, O my companion. ॥1॥
Make your consciousness stable, steady and still,
so that the wilderness and the household are the same to you.
Deep within, keep the One Husband Lord;
outwardly, attend to your many tasks.
Practise both royal power and Yoga.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਲੋਗ ਅਲੋਗੀ. ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੭॥
Says Nanak, this is to live among the people, yet remain apart from them, O my companion. ॥2॥1॥157॥
Let your only desire be for the One Lord.
Continually contemplate Him, through the Guru.
Implant the Mantra of the Saints firmly within, with understanding.
Serve at the feet of the Guru.
ਤਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਿ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Then you shall meet Him, by the Guru's grace, O my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
and the Lord is seen pervading all places.
The fear of death is taken away,
and one obtains a place at the root of the tree of the world, the Lord's feet.
Then all dependence on others ends. ॥1॥
One who has such destiny written on his forehead
He obtains his place in his own true home.
He enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord,
O Nanak, he merges in celestial peace, O my mind. ॥2॥2॥158॥
The Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue;
chant His Name in the melody of intuitive poise.
Through the Holy Guru, utter His praises with your tongue.
Hear: this is the way to be released.
ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡ ਪੁਨੀ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It is obtained by great good fortune, O my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The silent sages search for Him.
God is the Master of all;
He is so difficult to find in this world of Kali Yuga.
He is the Dispeller of pain;
God is the Fulfiller of all hopes, O my mind. ॥1॥
410: who does not perish, nor dies.
One who comes to know Him through the Guru —
O Nanak, his mind is pleased and appeased, O my mind. ॥2॥3॥159॥
Grasp the support of the One Lord.
Chant the Word of the Guru.
Submit to the Order of the True Lord.
Find the treasure within your mind.
Thus you shall be absorbed in peace, O my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who remains dead while yet alive
becoming the dust of the feet of all.
If I speak of the Fearless Lord,
This is what the Saint has taught, O my mind. ॥1॥
That humble being who takes his joy in the Name —
ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ; ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ; ਸੁਨੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
One who listens to the Praise of the Lord, Har, Har,
How fruitful is his coming into the world,
O Nanak, who is pleasing to God, O my mind. ॥2॥4॥160॥
Meeting together, sing the Praises of the Lord,
Those who are soaked in that sublime essence
They remain awake and aware night and day;
O Nanak, they are blessed with great good fortune, O my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Let us wash the feet of the Saints;
Becoming the dust of the feet of the Lord's slaves,
one shall not be afflicted by pain.
Taking to the sanctuary of the devotees,
one is no longer subject to birth and death.
They alone become steady and eternal,
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਜਪਿ ਲਏ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind. ॥1॥
You are my friend, my best friend.
Please implant Your Name within me.
Without Him, there is no other at all.
Let me not forget Him, even for an instant.
How could I live without Him?
I am a sacrifice to the Guru,
through whom Nanak chants the Name, O my mind. ॥2॥5॥161॥
You are the Creator, the Cause of causes.
I can think of no other.
Whatever You do comes to pass.
One who falls at God's door abides in intuitive peace and poise,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪਏ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
having fallen at the door of God, O my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Joining the company of the Holy,
Since I gave up my self-conceit,
Please shower Your mercy upon me,
and preserve my honour, O Lord of the world, O my mind. ॥1॥
Know that this alone is peace:
to one who becomes the dust of the feet of the Saints.
One whom the Lord Himself protects
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋ ਚਖੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥
tastes the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, O my mind. ॥2॥
One who has no one of his own —
God knows the state of our innermost being;
this is Nanak's prayer, O my mind. ॥3॥6॥162॥
O stranger soul, only a guest in this world,
That with which you are entangled,
